name: LoCoMo (Origin) · 4o-mini (Hint)
description: RerankMem hint mode and literature baselines evaluated with gpt-4o-mini as the answer model, on the original LoCoMo QA set (1986 questions), scored with the official snap-research token-F1 metric per question category. Memory graphs/stores for every method are reused directly from the existing qwen3-8b/deepseek-v4-flash extraction runs (answer-model-independent cache key) — only the answer phase was re-run with gpt-4o-mini. The adversarial category (5) is excluded from every row shown here, same as locomo-origin — its near-zero refusal-style scores are not comparable to the other four categories, so headline/avg is the n-weighted mean over categories 1-4 only (1540 questions).
